title: The Plan
tryWithClaude: Ask Claude: what is the best next step in my Plan?

steps.say: This is your Plan. It lists the work worth doing next, best first.
Each row says what is wrong and why it matters. This model has a few gaps on purpose.
Run the plan does every ready row together. This tour only shows you the button.
History keeps every change. Each line can be undone, so nothing is lost.
Pending changes lists what is not saved yet.
